title: Window resize in 4.6.3 not working
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - 'Gentoo' '2.18' on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Laptop GPU - AMD Ryzen 9 5900HX with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 30.73 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm running into a situation where a projectt in 4.6.3 does not resize the window when calling `get_window().size =`. This works in my 4.4 project, though. I'm not sure what changed since then except I do see there's a "display manager" option for operating systems, so maybe something related?

### Steps to reproduce

Create a project in godot 4.6.3 (linux/wayland?) and add this to some area that gets hit in the startup flow:
```
		print("Before size: %s" % get_window().size)
		print("Before requested: %s" % requested_resolution)
		get_window().size = requested_resolution
		print("After size: %s" % get_window().size)
```
Notice that the resolution doesn't change and the printout in the debugger shows:
```
Before size: (1920, 1080)
Before requested: (1366, 768)
After size: (1920, 1080)
```

edit: Should be noted that I have tried both the x11 and wayland display driver settings, which don't make a difference. I also made a project with a super simple node3d in it that had the following code, created in 4.4. Once I 'migrated' the project to 2.6.3, the issue continued - which confirmed some kind of change between the versions. I also went from 4.4->4.5.1 which did not reproduce the issue. 4.5.1->4.6.0 does persist. And I went as far as downloading 4.7 to see if the bug was resolved recently (it isn't): `Godot v4.7.stable - 'Gentoo' '2.18' on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Laptop GPU - AMD Ryzen 9 5900HX with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 30.73 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)`

```
extends Node3D


func _ready() -> void:
	var requested_resolution = Vector2(1366, 768)
	print("Before size: %s" % get_window().size)
	print("Before requested: %s" % requested_resolution)
	get_window().size = requested_resolution
	print("After size: %s" % get_window().size)
```

EDIT 2: Looks like this works when the project's built, but doesn't work within the engine itself. So perhaps it's related to the engine's window settings or something not accepting overrides.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

n/a (see above)
